title: DPO on Misaligned Preference Pairs: Can Misaligned Models Be Realigned Without Reward Models?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: A cheap post-hoc DPO realignment procedure is highly practical. Directly addresses the recovery problem after discovering emergent misalignment.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: DPO is simpler than RLHF and well-supported by TRL. Starting from an existing emergently misaligned model (using Betley et al. code). Creating curated preference pairs is the main design challenge.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused experiment: start with misaligned model, apply DPO, measure realignment. One variable (DPO dataset size). Requires producing the misaligned model first, which adds setup time. Tight but feasible in 30 hours.
